```plato
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trefoil_knot
    TrefoilKnot(t: Angle): Point3D
        => (t.Sin + (t * 2.0).Sin * 2.0,
            t.Cos + (t * 2.0).Cos * 2.0,
            -(t * 3.0).Sin);
```
